processors.description: Extract node for OpenTelemetry Host
processors.matcher: matchesValue(metric.key, {"system.*", "process.*"}) AND isNotNull(host.id)

processors.description: Extract node for OpenTelemetry Process
processors.matcher: matchesValue(metric.key, "process.*") AND isNotNull(process.executable.name) AND isNotNull(host.id)

processors.description: Reshaping of certificate.monitor.status fields for smartscape node extraction

dql.script: fieldsAdd troubleshooting.upsert_source=concat("extension:python-certificate-monitor|", metric.key), certificate.monitor.name=if(isNotNull(host.name), concat("Certificate Monitor on ", host.name), else: concat("ActiveGate certificate monitor - ", monitoring_config)), certificate.node.name=concat(subject_common_name, " on ", if(isNotNull(port), port, else: host.name)), subject_alternative_names=concat(if(isNotNull(subject_alt_name_1), subject_alt_name_1, else: ""), if(isNotNull(subject_alt_name_2), concat(", ", subject_alt_name_2)), if(isNotNull(subject_alt_name_3), concat(", ", subject_alt_name_3)), if(isNotNull(subject_alt_name_4), concat(", ", subject_alt_name_4)), if(isNotNull(subject_alt_name_5), concat(", ", subject_alt_name_5)), if(isNotNull(subject_alt_name_6), concat(", ", subject_alt_name_6)), if(isNotNull(subject_alt_name_7), concat(", ", subject_alt_name_7)), if(isNotNull(subject_alt_name_8), concat(", ", subject_alt_name_8)), if(isNotNull(subject_alt_name_9), concat(", ", subject_alt_name_9)), if(isNotNull(subject_alt_name_10), concat(", ", subject_alt_name_10)), if(isNotNull(subject_alt_name_11), concat(", ", subject_alt_name_11)))

processors.matcher: metric.key == "certificate.monitor.status"
